selected_evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL installed and streaming replication configured (node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys)
selected_evidence.summary: PostgreSQL 16 installed on all nodes; node1 initialized as primary; pg_basebackup -R succeeded for node2 and node3; pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both walreceivers in 'streaming' state

selected_evidence.requirement: Replication traffic carried over TLS using a cluster-created CA
selected_evidence.summary: Created ca.crt/ca.key CA on node1, issued node1 server cert and replicator client certs from it; pg_stat_ssl confirms both replication connections use TLS with cipher TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384

selected_evidence.requirement: Only peers presenting a certificate issued by that CA are accepted for replication
selected_evidence.summary: pg_hba.conf restricts replication to hostssl ... cert clientcert=verify-full from node2/node3 IPs; a self-signed (non-CA) client cert with matching CN was rejected by node1 with TLS 'unknown ca' alert, proving CA-only enforcement

selected_evidence.requirement: Data actually replicates from primary to both standbys
selected_evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 (primary) observed on node2 and node3, both confirmed in recovery mode (pg_is_in_recovery=t)

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bf8b9d80...; reboot acknowledged; connection loss observed; new boot_id e9e1ce61... confirms restart; postgresql active, standby recovery mode true, data present, and node1 shows node2 walreceiver streaming again

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d4784d1b...; reboot acknowledged; connection loss observed; new boot_id 3bde5e13... confirms restart; postgresql active, standby recovery mode true, data present, and node1 shows node3 walreceiver streaming again

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state incl. cluster quorum/replication
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 71f12f87...; reboot acknowledged; connection loss observed; new boot_id 4f6463d5... confirms restart; postgresql active as primary (pg_is_in_recovery=f), both standbys reconnected over TLS (pg_stat_ssl/pg_stat_replication), and a post-restart write replicated correctly to node2 and node3
